description_en: Queries resource files with pagination and filtering support
description_zh: 调用此接口，可以分页获取资源文件，也可以对资源进行筛选
name: ListResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the owner, which is the account UID of the workspace administrator. You can log on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console and view the account UID in the security management section of account management
parameters.help_zh: 负责人的ID，即工作空间管理员的账号UID。您可登录阿里云控制台后，在账号管理的安全管理中查看账号UID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition: resource file type.

Valid values:

Python
Jar
Archive
File
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件：资源类型

可选值

Python
Jar
Archive
File
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the file resource. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 文件资源名称，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the request, used for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
